## What changes

## Checklist
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material.
- [ ] No confidential employer, customer or NDA-covered information is included.
- [ ] Test artifacts are synthetic, authored for this project, or have documented provenance (`provenance.yaml`).
- [ ] External specifications used are publicly accessible.
- [ ] New architecture or device constants are profile/spec facts with a documented public source.
- [ ] No unexplained magic addresses in analysis code.
- [ ] Evidence classification (observed / derived / inferred / unknown / conflict) is preserved.
- [ ] Parsers stay fail-safe: unknown input becomes a parse event, never silently dropped or guessed.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest` and `python scripts/check_repo.py` pass.
